## Step 6: Hit Handling  
### Type 1: Sanctions Hit (OFAC/EU/HMT/UN)  
**Action: IMMEDIATE BLOCK**  
**Steps:**
1. Account FROZEN immediately (no transactions permitted)
2. Escalate to Compliance Head + Head of Financial Crime
3. Notify OFSI (UK Treasury) within 24 hours (if UK sanctions hit)
4. File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) with NCA
5. Document hold reason in system
6. Do NOT inform customer of reason (tipping off risk)  
**Customer Communication (If Account Opened):**
- Generic message: "Your account has been frozen pending review"
- No mention of AML/sanctions (confidential)
- Escalate to manager if customer questions  
**Timeline:** Immediate + regulatory notification within 24 hours  
**Outcome Options:**
- ✅ Hit confirmed as false positive → Unfreeze, apologize, proceed
- ❌ Hit confirmed as true positive → Remain frozen, potential account closure

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Hit Handling Process
raw_entities.description: Immediate response procedure for sanctions hits detected during account screening against OFAC, EU, HMT, and UN sanctions lists. Requires immediate account freeze, escalation to compliance leadership, regulatory notification to OFSI within 24 hours, and SAR filing with NCA. Customer communication is restricted to prevent tipping off.
context: Step 6: Hit Handling
Type 1: Sanctions Hit (OFAC/EU/HMT/UN)
Action: IMMEDIATE BLOCK
Timeline: Immediate + regulatory notification within 24 hours

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze on Sanctions Hit
raw_entities.description: First action upon detection of a sanctions hit: account is frozen immediately with no transactions permitted. This is a precautionary measure pending compliance review and regulatory notification.
context: Account FROZEN immediately (no transactions permitted)
Action: IMMEDIATE BLOCK

raw_entities.name: Escalation to Compliance Leadership
raw_entities.description: Sanctions hit is escalated immediately to both the Compliance Head and Head of Financial Crime for senior review and decision-making on next steps.
context: Escalate to Compliance Head + Head of Financial Crime

raw_entities.name: OFSI Regulatory Notification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory notification to OFSI (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation, UK Treasury) within 24 hours when a UK sanctions hit is confirmed. This is a regulatory obligation for UK-based financial institutions.
context: Notify OFSI (UK Treasury) within 24 hours (if UK sanctions hit)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing
raw_entities.description: Mandatory filing of a Suspicious Activity Report with the National Crime Agency (NCA) as part of the sanctions hit response procedure. This documents the suspicious activity and regulatory action taken.
context: File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) with NCA

raw_entities.name: System Documentation of Hold Reason
raw_entities.description: Internal system recording of the reason for account freeze, creating an audit trail and compliance record of the sanctions hit and the action taken.
context: Document hold reason in system

raw_entities.name: Customer Communication on Account Freeze
raw_entities.description: Generic customer communication informing them that their account has been frozen pending review, without disclosing the AML or sanctions reason to avoid tipping off. If customer questions the freeze, the matter is escalated to a manager.
context: Generic message: "Your account has been frozen pending review"
No mention of AML/sanctions (confidential)
Escalate to manager if customer questions

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Hit Confirmation Decision
raw_entities.description: Critical decision point determining whether the sanctions hit is a false positive or a confirmed true positive. This decision determines whether the account is unfrozen and the customer relationship continues, or the account remains frozen with potential closure.
context: Hit confirmed as false positive → Unfreeze, apologize, proceed
Hit confirmed as true positive → Remain frozen, potential account closure

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance officer responsible for receiving escalation of sanctions hits and making decisions on account freeze confirmation and regulatory response.
context: Escalate to Compliance Head + Head of Financial Crime

raw_entities.name: Head of Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Senior financial crime officer responsible for receiving escalation of sanctions hits and determining appropriate regulatory and operational response.
context: Escalate to Compliance Head + Head of Financial Crime

raw_entities.name: Account Manager
raw_entities.description: Manager responsible for handling customer inquiries about account freeze when customer questions the reason for the freeze.
context: Escalate to manager if customer questions

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint verifying that customer and account details are screened against OFAC, EU, HMT, and UN sanctions lists. A hit at this checkpoint triggers immediate account freeze and regulatory response.
context: Type 1: Sanctions Hit (OFAC/EU/HMT/UN)
Account FROZEN immediately (no transactions permitted)

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening of customer and account against multiple sanctions lists including OFAC (US), EU sanctions, HMT (UK), and UN sanctions lists. Hits trigger immediate account freeze and regulatory notification.
context: Type 1: Sanctions Hit (OFAC/EU/HMT/UN)
Account FROZEN immediately (no transactions permitted)

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Hit Suspicious Activity Report
raw_entities.description: Mandatory Suspicious Activity Report filed with the National Crime Agency (NCA) when a sanctions hit is detected and confirmed. Part of the regulatory response to sanctions violations.
context: File Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) with NCA

raw_entities.name: Account Holder Subject to Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Customer whose account is subject to sanctions screening and who may be matched against OFAC, EU, HMT, or UN sanctions lists. If a hit occurs, the customer is notified generically without disclosure of the sanctions reason.
context: Customer Communication (If Account Opened)
Generic message: "Your account has been frozen pending review"
Do NOT inform customer of reason (tipping off risk)

raw_entities.name: Account Subject to Sanctions Hit
raw_entities.description: Customer account that has been frozen due to a sanctions hit detection. No transactions are permitted on the account pending compliance review and determination of whether the hit is a false positive or true positive.
context: Account FROZEN immediately (no transactions permitted)
Your account has been frozen pending review
